dos: Do keep every number tabular so the layout holds still while scrubbing.
Do use green only for pairing state and red only for the live value.
Do name every error with its recovery.
Do encode bar lengths as exact proportions of the top class.
donts: Don't nest panels or add shadows, gradients, or rounded corners.
Don't show a frame the server did not read from data/raw/ — no mock clouds, ever.
Don't add a fourth accent or use a lamp color decoratively.
Don't put kickers above headings or gradient fills in text.
keyCharacteristics: Instrument blocks with steel hairline borders, square corners, zero shadows.
One red, one amber, one green — each with a single job (live, motion, paired).
Tabular mono numerals everywhere a number can change.
narrative.overview: Veyra Scope looks like the rack instrument it behaves as: charcoal powder-coat panels separated by deep gaps, bone silkscreen caps labeling every control, LED-red reserved for the live value, amber for the sweep in motion.

rules.body: Red, amber, and green each own exactly one meaning (live, motion, paired). No fourth accent, no lamp used as decoration.
rules.name: The Three Lamps Rule

rules.body: Data always sits on the darkest surface (#0b0b0b); chrome never competes with the cloud.
rules.name: The Void Rule

rules.body: Every changing number sets font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums so scrubbing never jitters the layout.
rules.name: The Tabular Figures Rule

rules.body: Elevation is declared once, with a 1px steel border.
rules.name: The Flat Panel Rule

readout.purpose: The single oversized live number (frame id).
